info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening CLS Activations API
Creates a new CLS offer activation of an account.

items.docs: Provides the ability for CLS clients to add a new CLS offer activation, in real-time, as Customers pick and link their cards to specific Offers.

info.name: Returns a list of all CLS offer activations of an account or filter based on search criteria in the request.

params.name: account_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the given account.

items.docs: Returns a list of all CLS activations of an account or filter based on search criteria in the request. This end point will only accept RANAC as a path parameter.

info.name: Updates an existing CLS offer activation of an account.

params.name: account_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the given account.

params.name: activation_id
params.description: The unique identifier for the given account.

items.docs: Provides the ability for the rewards system Value Network (VN) clients to update an existing CLS offer activation as Customers pick and link their card to specific Offers.
